label: Admissible root withholding (WITHHOLD_1) cells supply accessible per-effect withholding (WITHHOLD_2)
description: Re-presentation of premise (a) in the choice register, not independent support for it (#2103). For the same actual root and grounded actual concretum, the representative belongs to its own withholding cell (WITHHOLD_1) by reflexivity. The map sends it to an accessible world where the root exists and where it does not give that concretum being (WITHHOLD_2). The proof uses the cell only at its representative, and 46a468b2 is the only passage from sense 1 to sense 2; no agentive content of sense 1 is carried into fbd0a6d3. With the branching frame, moment and world map unconstrained and at most one actual root (which a common actual root secures: uniqueRootOfCommonRoot), some representation satisfies both premises exactly when fbd0a6d3 holds (Lean cellsRepresentationIff, discrete partition). The argument adds warrant for fbd0a6d3 only if an independently fixed decision partition and world map are supplied. The frontier counts it as proving fbd0a6d3 from open premises; that records no further warrant. Neither uniformity across effects nor a fixed setup is a premise of this per-effect conclusion.
